brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting exposure, as an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event [MG-023]. Where forced cooling is partially unavailable, reduce permissible load in proportion to the cooling capacity lost, noting that ONAN cooling type has no forced cooling fans to adjust [MG-021]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
